definitions.name: G2A.STDDEV
definitions.note: population standard deviation of a numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G2A.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G2A.XS' BIND G2A.XS G2A.XS G1A.MIN - G2A.XS G1A.RANGE /
definitions.note: rescale each number to (x - min) / (max - min), Vector in original order

definitions.name: G2A.LEN
definitions.note: character count of a String, bare scalar

definitions.name: G2A.CAP
definitions.body: 'G2A.CS' BIND G2A.CS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER G2A.CS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: Vector of one-char Strings (from CHARS) to a String with its first letter upper-cased

definitions.name: G2A.TITLE
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS G2A.CAP ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: space-separated String to title case, words joined by single spaces

definitions.name: G2A.LONGEST
definitions.note: length of the longest word in a space-separated String, bare scalar

definitions.name: G2A.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word of a space-separated String
